definition: the brief surfacings every ninety minutes or so, and what I use them for

settled:
I come up between every sleep cycle, so every ninety minutes to a hundred and ten.

They are brief, and they usually resolve back into sleep within seconds without my doing anything.

They do not break up the recovery. An hour slept still pays back an hour of capacity across a night full of them.

They are also the window where I retune things. Moving the weighted blanket from the legs to the whole body, or back, happens at one of them.

title: What Happens Between My Sleep Cycles
